title: Identity, access and compliance architecture (enterprise + federal desk)
scenario: LFG's help desk serves its own employees and, under a federal task order, a federal agency's staff with public-trust agents on site in Woodlawn, MD. Agents are split across the US and Monterrey, developers in Pune, and phone MFA resets were social-engineered twice this year. Design agent identity, access scoping, caller verification, the federal boundary and retention.
task: SAML SSO and IdP-driven user lifecycle for both desks
RBAC + tag-based access control + hierarchy, mapped to every site/queue rule
Tiered caller verification incl. OTP, CLEAR and authenticated portal chat
GovCloud/FedRAMP boundary, public trust, retention and audit
acceptance: Review-only: rubric scores boundary, identity, authorization, verification, data protection
Uses real feature limits (TBAC tag limits, GovCloud gaps, Voice ID end of support)

practices.label: Week 9 - SAML/SSO, RBAC and tag-based access control
